dig-ok-wait-1.text: Oklahoma: give notice at least 48 hours before digging, not counting the day of the notice, Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays. So a notice given on a Monday can be dug Thursday when there is no holiday in between. Demolition needs 7 business days.
